newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT, April in China venture.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT, April in China venture.

text.p: Dutch paper group KNP BT said on Thursday its KNP Leykam unit and Asia Pacific Resources International Holdings Ltd (April) planned a 50/50 joint venture producing paper near Shanghai, China.
The firms said in a joint statement that the current link-up should be seen as a first step, and that both firms planned to extend the partnership in the future.
"It is our aim to extend our co-operation in the field of production and marketing of woodfree paper," both firms said.
KNP BT had 1996 turnover of 13.6 billion guilders ($7 billion).
Asian pulp-producer April is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
No financials details were given on the deal.
